honest_limitations: flash point is a method-dependent apparatus quantity: closed-cup literature values scatter ~+-2-4 K between sources and open-cup runs a few K higher; the graded metric is therefore the discrete GHS category + a Kelvin MAE benchmarked to Catoire's ~2.9 K, not a sub-1% MAPE.

two GHS-category misses (ethylbenzene, n-butyl acetate) are both solvents whose experimental FP sits within ~2 K of the 23 C Cat2/Cat3 boundary and whose literature FP straddles it; the prediction is within truth uncertainty.

Catoire is a PURE-COMPONENT correlation; a real solvent BLEND flash point is governed by the most volatile component's partial pressure (non-ideal, activity-coefficient) and is a Phase-1 extension, not claimed here.
isomers with identical Joback first-order groups (o- vs p-xylene) share the Track B Joback Tb; Track A uses their distinct experimental Tb and resolves them.
outside the stated Catoire validity box (Tb 250-650 K, dHvap 20-110 kJ/mol, nC 1-21) the correlation is not asserted; all panel solvents are inside it.

kpis.core_domain_definition: aromatic, aliphatic, cyclic, ketone and ester coating solvents (non-associating); alcohols reported separately as BOUNDARY (self-associating, though Catoire captures H-bonding via dHvap)

ghs_category_misses.note: exp closed-cup FP sits exactly on the 23 C GHS Cat2/Cat3 line (EC 440/2008 A.9 = 23 C; some vendor SDS quote 15-21 C).
exp closed-cup FP quoted 22-27 C across GESTIS/CRC/SDS; the 23 C GHS boundary falls inside that literature scatter.

kpis.ghs_miss_note: every GHS category miss is a solvent whose experimental closed-cup FP sits within ~2 K of the 23 C Cat2/Cat3 boundary AND whose literature FP scatter straddles that boundary (see fp_boundary_note); the predicted FP is within truth uncertainty of the line. No miss crosses more than one category or exceeds the flammable/combustible 60 C line.
kpis.self_consistency_triangulation: Track A feeds INDEPENDENT experimental Tb and dHvap298 into the Catoire equation and recovers the INDEPENDENT experimental flash point to a few K for every core solvent; a materially wrong tabulated Tb or dHvap298 would not reproduce FP, so the agreement cross-validates the thermodynamic inputs as well as the flash point.
kpis.trackA_definition: Catoire FP from EXPERIMENTAL Tb + dHvap298 + exact nC (isolates the correlation's own error)
kpis.trackB_definition: Catoire FP with the boiling point REPLACED by its Joback structure-only prediction (novel-molecule path; exponent-0.797 dominant input)

per_solvent.fp_boundary_note: exp closed-cup FP sits exactly on the 23 C GHS Cat2/Cat3 line (EC 440/2008 A.9 = 23 C; some vendor SDS quote 15-21 C).
exp closed-cup FP quoted 22-27 C across GESTIS/CRC/SDS; the 23 C GHS boundary falls inside that literature scatter.

rights.in_scope: marine two-part epoxy-amine coating thinner / co-solvent chemistries; flammability class / IMDG shipping / EHS gate; no adjacent-industry data
rights.predictor_method: Catoire-Naudet correlation -- published theory, freely usable
rights.thermo_inputs: Tb, dHvap298, nC -- tabulated NIST/CRC facts (non-copyrightable)

target_capability: a-priori CLOSED-CUP FLASH POINT and GHS flammable-liquid category for coating solvents/reactive diluents -- the regulatory/shipping capstone that consumes the already-anchored boiling-point (Joback) and enthalpy-of-vaporization (Joback) axes plus the exact carbon count and predicts the flammability class no other module supplies

theory.ground_truth: independent experimental CLOSED-CUP flash points (GESTIS / CRC / PubChem-aggregated regulatory values; ethylbenzene 23 C per EC 440/2008 A.9)
theory.non_circularity: the four Catoire constants were regressed on a SEPARATE 59-compound set and are NOT re-fit here; ground-truth FP are independent experimental measurements; no parameter is tuned on this validation panel
theory.operational_kpi: discrete GHS flammable-liquid CATEGORY exact-match plus Kelvin MAE benchmarked against Catoire's own ~2.9 K (flash point truth is method-dependent; a discrete class + Kelvin MAE is the honest operational metric, not a spurious sub-1% MAPE)
theory.predictor: Catoire & Naudet 2004 unique flash-point equation: FP = 1.477*Tb^0.79686*dHvap298^0.16845*nC^(-0.05948)
theory.predictor_citation: Catoire, L.; Naudet, V. J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 2004, 33(4), 1083-1111
theory.predictor_reported_accuracy: mean abs deviation ~2.9 K, max ~7 K; valid Tb 250-650 K, dHvap 20-110 kJ/mol, nC 1-21
theory.thermo_inputs: Tb: CRC/NIST normal boiling points (shared panel with the boiling-point / dHvap audits); dHvap298: NIST WebBook / Majer-Svoboda 298.15 K enthalpies of vaporization; nC: exact
theory.trust_guard: Joback group multisets formula-checked vs RDKit and byte-identical to the boiling-point/dHvap audits; self-consistency triangulation of Tb & dHvap298 through the recovered FP

verdict.authority: AUDIT_ONLY -- graded domain-of-applicability study, NOT a Phase-0 gate
verdict.gate_logic: core Track A: MAE<=5K (Catoire ref ~2.9K) AND max_abs_err<=8K (ref ~7K) AND >=(n-2) within +-5K AND GHS-category exact match >=80% AND spearman(FP order)>=0.95 AND lift>=60%
